resource.title: React Advanced Odontogram — engine-local codes
resource.description: Engine-local codes emitted by the React Advanced Odontogram FHIR export: finding types (Observation.code), enum values (valueCodeableConcept / component codes), periodontal-panel component and qualifier codes, 2017-classification stage summaries and case-condition laterality. Displays are language-neutral English and match the export verbatim; a repeated value code carries its alternative displays as designations. Plugin-defined `custom-state:<pluginId>` codes are open-ended and intentionally not enumerated.
